independent_review.finding: No cross-connection, selection-reuse or financial-authority gap found in this delta; recommended unused-reader deadline guard added and passed.

negative_fault_injection: View exception while canonical read is pending
Retain a real canonical query result until this same deadline plus20ms; force only shell policy label toNO_VERIFICADO so the real catalog view does not consume the pending shadow property.
semantics: SQLite source capture and canonical four-role read are independent and start together within one absolute deadline.
The source copy connection remains on the rendering thread.
A result is shared only within that request and only for identical normalized selectors with the default canonical reader.
Different filters/offset/funnel offset or an explicit generation reader retain their own read.
Worker is joined before closing capture resources on success, capture failure, view failure and BaseException.
An expired request discards the body and does not reopen generation or fall back.
